description:
My only childhood friend, Jeha, suffered sudden amnesia due to an unexpected accident. 

"Who are you?" 

I was terrified by Jeha's unfamiliar face, seeing him as if for the first time. As if all our past memories would vanish into thin air. 

'I don't want us to grow apart like this. If only we could start over from the beginning!' 

So I blurted it out. "W-we were lovers!" 

*** 

*Gulp* 

"Looks like you really were my girlfriend, seeing as I'm getting hard just from you." 

I had somewhat expected it... But the pace is this fast?! 

'This, this isn't right...' 

"Looks like you have time to think about other things." 

At that moment, Jeha's member penetrated me from below. 

"Ah! H-hup, th-that, ugh!" 

My head felt like it would break every time my hips were thrust up. Tears wouldn't stop from the pain, but what was this crazy pleasure? 

'Is this what it means to... come?' 

The lie should have been planned carefully!
